advice: Abstain. The measured full512 path already uses one SME streaming region for the GEMM call. The verified 256 helper owns its SME entry and exit, so the seven-call Strassen wrapper crosses that boundary seven times. The supplied results measure complete paths and do not isolate transition or ZA setup cost. Avoid proposing a fused region without a valid helper ABI change supported by evidence.
risks: A fused-region variant would change the generated helper’s SME boundary and could violate its streaming or ZA state contract. Its result would also include the existing Strassen packing, arithmetic, and recombination costs; do not attribute a joint outcome to transition savings. Any future candidate must preserve correctness and time all work inside gemm, then pass the unchanged ten-run paired-control and held-out gates.
